description: This Java source file defines a database migration class 'Migration_13_14' for the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It handles migrating widget preferences stored in SharedPreferences into a new database table, creating the table, transferring data, and cleaning up old preferences. It also triggers widget updates via broadcast intents.

classes.name: Migration_13_14
classes.description: A migration class extending Room's Migration to handle schema and data migration from version 13 to 14, specifically migrating widget preferences from SharedPreferences to a database table.

methods.name: Migration_13_14
methods.description: Constructor initializing the migration with context and version range.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Performs the migration: creates new table, transfers widget preferences from SharedPreferences to database, cleans up old preferences, and triggers widget updates.
